title: Have you been to any of these places?

classification.question_topic: Asking whether others recognize recurring Mall World locations (Whale Lake, Market Road, Mega Beach Hotel).

meta.author_theory: They believe they are 'for sure in Mall World' after seeing similar bathrooms on TikTok and exploring the sub.

position.relative_to: Viewed from a road; pavilion on the left side when looking from the road; stream runs alongside the road and goes into the lake from the left; mountains in background.

qualities.raw_description: Frozen-type lake; size varies depending on where you’re looking at it from; sometimes has ice and waves. Dark brown wooden pavilion on the left side if looking at it from the road. Stream alongside a road goes into the lake from the left. Mountains in the background. You can go tubing down the stream; it winds down to the lake. Lake has 2 giant whales (maybe more); when you first see them in the water they’re so big all you see is black.

position.relative_to: Off of a super high scary highway; a little narrow road you can sometimes drive down; most of the time walking; possibly near/on water; 'beach restaurant vibes'.

qualities.raw_description: Little narrow road (sometimes drivable) off a super high scary highway; most of the time walking. Rows in weird patterns of little shops and restaurants that look like shacks or little shipping containers with fabric awnings. One restaurant is an actual building; inside you go up a few steps then a ramp to the booths. Normally a bit busy. Red checkered table clothes. Might be on the water; beach restaurant vibes.

position.relative_to: Dreamer is normally on the roof; roof overlooks the ocean or turns into sand and has ocean access; pools and beach are on top area connecting towers.

qualities.raw_description: Normally on the roof. Roof either overlooks the ocean, or turns into sand and has ocean access. From here you’ll see weird things above the water. Hotel looks like two giant tower pillars with points at the top of both, connected by a shorter building; on top is the area where the pools and beach are.

connections.qualities: Walking along a narrow market road; sometimes can drive down from a super high scary highway.
Tubing down a stream that winds down to the lake; stream runs alongside a road and enters the lake from the left.

interactions.description: Avoiding letting the tube go into the lake because it is scary in there.
Seeing 'weird things above the water' from the roof/ocean overlook.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is framed as a question but contains detailed recurring-location descriptions. Some fields (light quality, time of day, cleanliness, specific entities beyond whales) were not provided. Water presence coded as ocean-like for the lake due to 'waves' and scale; exact classification is ambiguous.
